the console hides to the tray and can be restored
real source is sent only after A; reviewed exact draft is saved only after B
a slow real summary permits chat, survives hiding, and cancellation discards late output
office through actual UI, IPC, model transport and Docker

specs.title: [FR-14] 真实离线BGE在Electron中召回独立偏好并进入实际对话请求
[FR-15] memory source opens its history and scoped clearing leaves no stale extraction notice
[FR-15] settings reports real IPC clear failures and keeps persisted memory visible
[FR-15] a retained conversation can learn new facts after clearing only its memories
[FR-15] clearing the original conversation keeps corrected memory in its actual source
[FR-15] clearing the correction conversation keeps corrected memory in its actual source
[NFR-U03] unusable local model does not silently become a successful empty memory search
an old failed chat cannot invalidate a newer actual model verification
removing a model during a real pending request still delivers its complete answer to the conversation
[FR-25] verified service status survives a completed chat and renderer reload
[FR-25] real chat failure and recovery update the current service without reloading
model setup has one complete result and notifications leave the chat composer usable
distinct errors remain scrollable and keyboard dismissible after routine notices expire
[FR-15] deleting the active history clears the open pet chat without restarting
[FR-02] body taps give tap feedback and the menu explicitly opens and closes chat
real pet follows current work, keeps a native loop and stops without celebrating stale output
[FR-27] native tray and pet hiding end recording tracks without submitting voice
[FR-27] a transcription returning through IPC after native hide cannot change the draft
[FR-16/FR-18] 取消待规划任务后，晚到的模型计划不能恢复审批或更换任务
[FR-17] 三步任务逐项批准接受本任务新增文件并完成
[FR-17] 三步任务逐项批准拦截外部新增文件
[FR-16] 新任务选择目录经真实 IPC 审批后整理文件，取消选择保留先前范围
[FR-18] 模型建议目录保持待确认，实际选择后才进入敏感操作审批
